events.title: Next Fest Demo Update

events.title: New Languages Have Arrived!
events.summary: Hey everyone, we're excited to announce that Booster Pack Heroes' demo now supports 9 new languages: • German • Simplified Chinese • Japanese • Korean • Russian • French • Spanish • Polish • Brazilian PortugueseThank you all for the incredible support!

events.title: Booster Pack Heroes launches November 10
events.summary: Launch Date!Hi everyone,The wait is almost over. Booster Pack Heroes launches on November 10th!And that’s not all - we’re bringing the game to Steam Next Fest this October (Oct 19 - Oct 26), giving everyone a chance to jump into the game and see what we’ve been working on ahead of launch. Make sure you wishlist if you haven’t yet, so you’ll get notified on launch day. Demo Update out today!Whether you have or haven't played the demo before, now is a great time to give it a go.
